requirements.summary: The synthesized netlist behaves as the RTL at every flop and output.
With scan_en held at 0 the netlist with scan behaves as the RTL, whatever scan_in does; without that assumption it does not.
With scan_en at 1 a bit given to scan_in leaves scan_out one clock per flop later.
A reset of the wrong polarity, a wrong reset value and exchanged multiplexer inputs are reported at the flop they change.
After the ECO the netlist behaves as the new RTL; against the old RTL only the alarm differs; a wrong gate in the ECO is reported.
